what: When hovering a list row, a pale band hidden outside the row’s left (2x the row width, ink 4% → transparent) sweeps in rightward in .8s cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1) and leaves a faint shade on the row, while the underline below (gray translucent 1px) is drawn from the left in .25s. On leave both return instantly (0s) — hovering again rewrites them from the start

options.--fx-ease: Band curve (css variable), default cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1) — the original Tailwind ease-out
options.[data-fx-part]: shine (band)·line (underline, optional) — place as an empty span at the very start of the line
